objective: Package one repeatable climate and coffee economics research benchmark with explicit source policy, claim gates, review rubric, eval cases, and honest comparison reporting.

first_domain_decision.decision_basis: The roadmap listed this domain and the repository already contains a coffee deliverable maturity fixture, allowing a domain pack without external credentials or live network calls.

generic_async_research_baseline.description: Baseline run representing generic operation without the Phase 10 domain pack, source policy, and runtime-backed claim gates.

upgraded_async_research_runtime.description: Candidate run representing the domain pack, source policy, trace-aware evals, claim gates, and deliverable maturity checks.

deep_research_style_output.description: No proprietary or manually captured Deep Research-style output is bundled. Attach only permissioned, dated, prompt-linked artifacts before making a product comparison.

human_review_baseline.description: The reviewer rubric defines the calibration path, but no private reviewer preference notes are packaged.

honest_claim_policy.allowed_statement: In the packaged climate/coffee economics fixture, the runtime-backed domain pack improves groundedness, unsupported-claim rate, accepted-output rate, freshness failures, and cost against the bundled generic baseline.
honest_claim_policy.forbidden_statement: async-research broadly beats ChatGPT Deep Research or other general-purpose Deep Research-style products.
honest_claim_policy.unproven_statement: Expert preference and proprietary Deep Research-style product comparisons remain unproven until permissioned paired outputs and calibrated reviewer scores are recorded.
